feature.name: MOSS post-meeting enhancement
feature.description: Internal review flow for MOSS candidates. It is off by default and needs the P3 candidate storage and activation API.

settings.title: MOSS post-meeting enhancement
settings.description: Read-only installation and health information from the MOSS backend.
settings.disabled: The internal MOSS feature is off. Turn it on under Beta only after the P3 backend is connected.
settings.nativeHotwordsNote: MOSS v0.2.2 does not provide native hotwords. Meetily may only apply saved, explicit aliases as traceable corrections.

workspace.title: Review MOSS candidate
workspace.description: MOSS runs after recording. A candidate is saved separately and never replaces the current transcript until you confirm activation.
workspace.nativeHotwordsWarning: Native hotwords are not supported. Corrections below come only from explicit aliases saved with this meeting and remain reversible.
workspace.noRuns: No MOSS candidate has been created for this meeting.
workspace.noReview: This run has no reviewable candidate.

comparison.saveLabel: Save edit for candidate segment starting at {{time}}
comparison.timeSourceAligned: Time: frozen source transcript ({{count}} anchors, {{confidence}}% match) · source {{hash}}
comparison.timeSourceAudioToken: Time: Whisper audio tokens {{first}}–{{last}} ({{confidence}}% match) · token track {{hash}}
comparison.alignmentAudit: {{aligned}} aligned segments · {{fallback}} original MOSS fallbacks · source {{hash}}
comparison.audioTokenAudit: Audio-token-assisted alignment: {{aligned}} segments · {{fallback}} raw fallbacks · {{coverage}}% global match · track {{hash}}
comparison.audioTokenFallback: Audio tokens were unavailable, so original boundaries were kept safely · reason {{reason}}
comparison.activityAudit: Last active audio {{lastActive}} · model last timestamp {{modelLast}} · difference {{delta}} ms
comparison.activityAuditSilent: No active audio was detected at -50 dBFS · model last timestamp {{modelLast}}
comparison.activeLocked: This activated candidate is read-only. Restore the previous transcript before changing it.

textLayers.audio_token_context: Text source: audio-token evidence and meeting context

speakers.title: Bind anonymous speakers
speakers.description: MOSS labels stay anonymous until you select a person from this meeting. Meetily never guesses a name.
speakers.noParticipants: This meeting has no saved participants. Anonymous labels will be kept.

terms.title: Traceable term corrections
terms.description: Corrections may use saved explicit aliases or meeting-context terms uniquely located by real Whisper audio tokens. Every correction keeps its source and remains reversible.
terms.none: No traceable context-term correction was recorded for this candidate.

activation.title: Activation and restore
activation.ready: Activation will save a snapshot of the current transcript before switching to this candidate.
activation.active: This MOSS candidate is the active transcript.
activation.confirmActivate: Activate this candidate? The backend must first verify that the current transcript has not changed.
activation.confirmRollback: Restore the snapshot from before MOSS activation? The current transcript must still match the active version.

blockers.CURRENT_TRANSCRIPT_CHANGED: The current transcript changed after this candidate was created. Refresh and review the conflict.
blockers.CANDIDATE_STALE: This candidate revision is stale. Refresh before activation.
blockers.CANDIDATE_INCOMPLETE: This candidate is incomplete and cannot be activated.

errors.integrationUnavailable: The MOSS command integration is unavailable in this desktop build. No candidate change or activation was completed.
errors.invalidResponse: The MOSS backend returned data that does not match the P4 contract.
errors.featureDisabled: The internal MOSS feature is disabled.
errors.unhealthy: MOSS is installed but not healthy.
errors.runAlreadyActive: A MOSS run is already active for this meeting.
errors.runNotFound: The selected MOSS run no longer exists.
errors.candidateNotReady: The candidate is not ready for review.
errors.candidateConflict: The candidate conflicts with the current transcript.
errors.candidateStale: The candidate changed. Refresh before saving again.
errors.invalidBinding: The speaker binding was rejected. No previous binding was changed.
errors.invalidOverride: The segment override was rejected. No previous assignment was changed.
errors.activationConflict: Activation was blocked because the current transcript changed. Existing text was kept.
errors.rollbackConflict: Restore was blocked because the active transcript changed. Existing text was kept.
errors.cancelFailed: Cancellation could not be confirmed. The run may still be active; refresh its status.
errors.qwenBusy: AI summary generation is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting MOSS enhancement.
errors.operationFailed: The MOSS operation failed. Existing audio and transcript data were kept.
errors.audioTooLong: MOSS currently supports recordings up to 20 minutes per run. Transcription did not start, and the existing audio and transcript were kept.
